zh-CN.title: 投稿工作台深度优化
items: 桌面端切换投稿时不再刷新整个工作台，列表、筛选与详情保持连续
手机端投稿详情采用独立会话标题栏，审批与投稿操作已合并到标题栏中

en.title: A smoother submission workspace
items: Switching submissions on desktop now keeps the workspace, list, filters, and detail view in place
Submission details on mobile now use a dedicated conversation header with workflow actions built in
